Gumansingh S/o Rajendra Prasad, Aged About 30 Years, R/o
Dhursi Ka Pura, Police Station Soorauth, District Karauli (Raj.).
 ----Applicant
 Versus
State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
 ----Respondent
For Applicant(s) : Mr. Timan Singh
For Respondent(s) : Ms. Arti Sharma, Pp
 Mr. Rhishi Raj Singh Rathore, Pp
 Mr. Rajesh Gadwal
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sameer Jain
 Order
06/11/2025
1.

The present bail application has been filed under Section 482 BNSS in connection with FIR No.
197/2024 registered at Police Station Nai Mandi Hindaun District Karauli for the offence(s) under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 & 120-B of IPC.
2.

entities.text: Police Station Nai Mandi Hindaun District Karauli
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the accused-applicant has submitted that vide an order dated 11.03.2025,
interim protection from arrest was granted to the applicant, subject to the condition that he joins the investigation at the concerned police station.
In compliance of the aforesaid, the applicant has duly joined the investigation.
It is further submitted that the matter at hand is triable by the Magistrate and civil suits are ongoing between the parties.

3. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have vehemantaly opposed the instant bail application on the ground of criminal antecedents and have further submitted that there exists an element of stamp fabrication by the applicant.

1 4.

Having heard the contentions put-forth by the counsel for the parties, considering that the matter at hand is triable by the Magistrate and considering the fact that the accused-applicant has already joined the investigation as directed vide an interim order dated 11.03.2025 and looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and material on record but without commenting on merits/demerits of the case, this court deems it appropriate to make the order dated 11.03.2025 absolute and allow the instant anticipatory bail application.
5. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is allowed.

The S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer, Police Station Nai Mandi Hindaun District Karauli in F.I.R. No. 197/2024 is directed that in the event of arrest of the accused-applicant Gumansingh S/o Rajendra Prasad shall be released on bail, provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties in the sum of Rs.25,000/-
each to the satisfaction of the S.H.O/I.O/Arresting Officer of the concerned Police Station on the following conditions:-
(i) that the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) that the applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or any police officer, and (iii) that the applicant shall not leave India without previous permission of the court.
